_about: The depths a Topo map can be made at. Each sets the floors the depth check holds a map to; depths.py documents every field. A machine adds its own under "depths" in Topo's config file, and a map's config can carry one inline. No depth can turn off the precision checks: every box cites real files and lines, and cited lines must match their symbols.

overview.about: applications, subsystems, modules and files, with symbol boxes only for the entry points and the main mechanisms

standard.about: down to the functions and classes that carry the logic

deep.about: every public class, function and method gets a symbol box
